backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for EcoPowerHubAI implementing access control, user profiles, system configuration, energy data management, Stripe integration, and HTTP outcalls for a smart energy optimization platform on ICP.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/.env.pinata.example: Example environment file template for Pinata IPFS API credentials, requiring PINATA_JWT and optionally PINATA_GATEWAY.
frontend/dist/.ic-assets.json5: ICP asset canister configuration defining cache-control headers and content types for various file types, with SPA fallback to index.html and security policy settings.
frontend/dist/index.html: Built HTML entry point for EcoPowerHub AI with full SEO metadata, Open Graph tags, PWA manifest, structured data schema, and hreflang tags for internationalization.
frontend/docs/build-optimization-notes.m: Documents post-optimization build changes including duplicate key fixes, React.lazy code splitting for non-initial routes, and Vite manual chunk configuration for vendor libraries.
frontend/docs/pinata-pinning.md: Guide for uploading files to IPFS using the Pinata SDK, covering prerequisites, environment variable setup, and usage instructions.
frontend/index.html: Source HTML entry point for the Vite-built EcoPowerHub AI frontend with SEO metadata, PWA configuration, Open Graph/Twitter cards, and a root div for React mounting.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: ICP domain verification file listing ecopowerhub.ai and www.ecopowerhub.ai as custom domains for the canister.
frontend/public/generated/.gitkeep: Empty placeholder file to keep the generated assets directory tracked in git.
frontend/public/generated/GENERATION_GUI: Detailed specifications for generating 57 PNG assets for EcoPowerHub AI, including dimensions, visual style, color palette, and per-asset design instructions across categories like branding, device logos, and setup guides.
frontend/public/generated/STYLE-GUIDE.tx: Visual style reference for EcoPowerHub AI defining the color palette, typography, design element rules, and asset requirements (logos, dashboards, avatars) along with optimization and accessibility guidelines.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest for EcoPowerHub AI specifying app metadata, icons, display mode, and shortcuts to the Dashboard and Diagnostics pages.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt that allows general crawling but disallows specific app routes (dashboard, domains, email-automation, deployment-status) and references the sitemap.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker (v128.1) implementing network-first caching for navigation and HTML, cache-first for static assets, and network-first for JS/CSS, with install-time precaching and old-cache cleanup on activation.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap listing all public EcoPowerHub AI URLs with priorities, change frequencies, and hreflang alternates for English, German, French, Hindi, and Spanish.
frontend/restore-assets.js: Node.js script that verifies all required PNG assets exist in frontend/public/generated/, creating the directory if absent and validating the complete asset inventory with expected dimensions.
frontend/scripts/pinata-fs-utils.mjs: Utility module providing deterministic, alphabetically sorted file discovery for a directory tree, plus helpers for getting file size and formatting bytes as human-readable strings.
frontend/scripts/pinata-pin.mjs: Node.js script that recursively pins files from a directory to IPFS using the Pinata SDK, generating a manifest mapping file paths to CIDs. Requires PINATA_JWT environment variable and optionally PINATA_GATEWAY.
frontend/scripts/poll-devices.cjs: Node.js polling script for EcoPowerHub.ai that calls the Equipa ICP canister via dfx to fetch data for a list of Shelly devices. Supports a continuous loop mode or a single-run mode (--once) suitable for cron jobs.
frontend/scripts/POLLING_SETUP.md: Guide for configuring the poll-devices.cjs script to run headlessly via cron or systemd using a plaintext dfx 'automation' identity with the --network local flag.
frontend/scripts/resend-ecopowerhub-logo: Reads the EcoPowerHub monochrome-dark 1024x1024 PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices to stdout as plain text. Intended for reassembling the image in parts.
Reads the EcoPowerHub monochrome-white 1024x1024 PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices to stdout as plain text. Mirrors the mono-dark slice script for the white variant.
Reads the EcoPowerHub full-color emblem 1024x1024 PNG, Base64-encodes it, and outputs one of four equal slices to stdout as plain text for incremental transmission or reassembly.
frontend/scripts/verify-no-deprecated-pi: Scans the frontend and backend source directories for deprecated Pinata API calls (e.g., pinata.upload.folder) and exits with an error if any are found. Used as a CI/pre-commit verification step.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the React application's router, query client, and top-level layout using TanStack Router and React Query, with lazy-loaded page components and an AppLayout that handles authentication state and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/SolarG: Displays affiliate marketing cards for solar generator brands (EcoFlow, Bluetti, Jackery) with product details, app features, tracking IDs, and CTA links.
frontend/src/components/affiliate/Tracki: Small UI component that displays an affiliate tracking ID with a clipboard copy button and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/AlarmNotificatio: A modal overlay component that displays a morning update (weather, energy summary, efficiency) when an alarm triggers, plays an alarm sound on mount, and supports text-to-speech readout with a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: A React class-based error boundary that catches unhandled render errors and displays a fallback UI with options to reload the page or navigate home.
frontend/src/components/AraChat.tsx: A floating chat widget that simulates a support assistant named Ara by responding to user messages with random pre-written helpful responses after a short delay.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddAla: A dialog component for creating a new morning alarm, collecting wake-up time, ringtone, alert beep, language, and active status, then submitting via the useAddAlarmConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/AddSys: A dialog component for adding a new energy system configuration (HVAC, etc.) with fields for system ID, API endpoint, auth token, brand, and region, submitting via the useAddSystemConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Alarms: A dashboard tab that lists all configured morning alarms with toggle, edit, and delete actions, and opens AddAlarmDialog or EditAlarmDialog for creating or modifying alarms.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Analyt: A dashboard tab displaying energy consumption analytics with an area chart (historical + 7-day forecast), deployment URL display with DNS/SSL status checks, and a JSON report download feature.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EditAl: A dialog component for editing an existing alarm configuration, allowing users to update wake-up time, ring tone, alert beep, language, and active status via a form that submits changes through the updateAlarmConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Energy: A Recharts-based line chart component that visualizes energy consumption (kWh) and temperature (°C) over time using dual Y-axes, accepting an array of EnergyData as props.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/EVAuth: A dialog component for connecting a Ford or Rivian EV via a mock OAuth flow, storing the resulting OAuth config through the useAddEVOAuthConfig mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: A dashboard tab that displays system health status, service statuses, and performance metrics fetched from the maintenance dashboard API, with color-coded indicators and a manual refresh button.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/MyEVCa: A card component displaying EV telemetry data (battery level, range, charging status) for a connected Ford or Rivian vehicle, with buttons to initiate solar charging or disconnect the vehicle.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Overvi: A dashboard overview tab that aggregates and displays energy consumption stats, average temperature, active system count, an energy chart, temperature gauge, and system status cards, with loading skeletons and an onboarding prompt when no systems exist.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Recomm: A dashboard tab that fetches and displays AI-powered energy optimization recommendations filtered by the user's preferred language, showing each recommendation in a card with badges and a summary alert about potential savings.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/System: Dashboard tab that displays energy system configurations, EV integration, and a polling status banner showing data freshness with warnings when the polling agent appears offline.
A component that renders a grid of cards showing the latest energy consumption and temperature data for each connected system, or an empty state prompt if no systems are configured.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Temper: Bar chart component that visualizes temperature readings per location from EnergyData, supporting Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle.
frontend/src/components/diagnostics/Smar: Panel that fetches and displays AI diagnostic events for devices, showing quality badges, status, diagnosis text, and error codes.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying copyright info and attribution links to caffeine.ai and EcoPowerHub.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky header component showing the EcoPowerHub AI logo, the logged-in user's name, a theme toggle, and a logout button, with responsive desktop and mobile (sheet drawer) layouts.
frontend/src/components/LoadingErrorBoun: A functional component that wraps children and shows a loading spinner, a timeout error, or a network error UI with a retry button based on loading/error state and a configurable timeout.
Renders the marketing site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, and legal links for EcoPowerHub AI.
Sticky marketing site header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, theme toggle, and dropdowns for region and language selection with localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name and preferred language, auto-detecting browser language, then saving the profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/RouteErrorFallba: Error boundary fallback UI displayed on route errors, offering buttons to navigate home, retry, or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/StableImage.tsx: Image component that prevents flickering during re-renders by showing a placeholder while loading and gracefully falling back to an error state or alternate source on failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions, covering user profiles, system configs, energy data, EV telemetry, diagnostics, and other domain queries/mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base/component/utility layers, CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and utility classes for grid backgrounds and image loading states.
frontend/src/lib/alarmService.ts: Provides alarm-related utilities including motivational message generation, alarm sound playback via Web Audio API, and text-to-speech morning energy/weather updates using the SpeechSynthesis API.
frontend/src/lib/assetRestoration.ts: Documents and exports metadata for all 58 required PNG assets (filenames, dimensions, purpose, usage) used across the application, serving as a reference for build validation scripts.
frontend/src/lib/assetVerification.ts: Exports a categorized list of all required generated asset paths and provides runtime verification utilities to check asset accessibility via HTTP HEAD requests.
frontend/src/lib/generatedAssetPaths.ts: Centralizes and exports typed path constants for all generated PNG assets stored in the /generated directory, covering branding, device logos, setup guides, and affiliate images.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Defines supported languages, regions, device brands, and system types, and exports utility functions for RTL detection, temperature unit conversion, timestamp formatting, and regional device mapping.
frontend/src/lib/weather.ts: Integrates with the Open-Meteo API to fetch current and hourly weather data by coordinates, and provides a geolocation helper to retrieve the user's current position.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/BestPracticesPage.tsx: A static informational page presenting best practices for energy monitoring systems, including maintenance schedules, troubleshooting tips, and performance optimization advice organized with accordions and cards.
frontend/src/pages/ComplianceSecurityPag: A compliance and security information page that displays regulatory and security details, with a print-to-PDF feature that triggers the browser print dialog and shows a toast notification on completion.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: The main dashboard page that renders a tabbed interface (Overview, Systems, Alarms, Insights, Analytics, and an admin-only Maintenance tab) with admin navigation buttons for Domains, Email, and Status pages.
An admin page for ICP Gateway domain configuration that checks accessibility of ecopowerhub.ai domains, displays deployment status, and provides setup instructions including the .well-known/ic-domains file configuration.
frontend/src/pages/DeviceIntegrationGuid: A page listing integration guides for supported energy monitoring devices (e.g., Emporia Vue), each with setup steps, troubleshooting tips, privacy notes, EcoToken benefits, and compatibility info displayed in collapsible cards.
frontend/src/pages/DiagnosticsPage.tsx: Renders a diagnostics page with tabs for smart diagnostics, regional electrical systems (voltage/frequency/plug types by continent), and documentation links with search/filter functionality.
frontend/src/pages/DomainPortfolioPage.t: Displays a domain portfolio strategy page with mock data showing availability, pricing, and registrar info for EcoPowerHub brand domain variants, noting that backend implementation is pending.
frontend/src/pages/EmailAutomationPage.t: Provides an email automation configuration UI with predefined keyword-based rules that map common support topics (e.g., Emporia connection, EcoTokens, billing) to short, founder-voice auto-responses.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the public marketing landing page with a full-screen hero section, device setup guide cards, and calls-to-action using the EcoPowerHub AI branding and green/blue color scheme.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles user authentication via Internet Identity, redirecting authenticated users to the dashboard and displaying feature highlights and a login button for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/MarketingCampaignAsse: Displays marketing campaign assets for EcoPowerHub AI, including a detailed 60-second video ad script with scene breakdowns and banner ad variants in multiple sizes/formats, with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/PartnerMarketplacePag: Renders a partner marketplace page listing curated affiliate programs (Sense, Emporia, Amazon Associates, ShareASale, CJ Affiliate) with commission details, benefits, and tracking IDs.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Static privacy policy page for Eco PowerHub AI LLC covering data collection, usage, sharing, and security practices, last updated December 1, 2025.
frontend/src/pages/SupportIntegrationsPa: Displays support and integrations information by fetching manufacturer support and support boundary data from the API, showing active integrations and what the platform does and does not support.
frontend/src/pages/TechSpecsPage.tsx: Shows technical specifications including a global voltage compatibility matrix, device specs for supported energy monitors, SCADA protocol support fetched from the API, and compliance standards.
frontend/src/routes/RootRoute.tsx: Minimal root route component that renders a TanStack Router Outlet as the top-level layout entry point.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines all frontend TypeScript interfaces and types (SystemConfig, EnergyData, Recommendation, EVTelemetry, PricingTier, etc.) that mirror the backend Motoko canister data structures for the EcoPowerHub.ai platform.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
frontend/vite-build-verify.js: Post-build verification script that checks the dist output for required PNG image assets (logos, setup guides, app images) with expected filenames and dimensions.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration for the React frontend, defining manual chunk splitting for vendor libraries, a dev proxy to the local ICP replica, path aliases, and environment variable injection for canister/DFX variables.
project_state.json: Project state tracker for EcoPowerHub.ai documenting known build errors (missing HashMap import, timestamp=0 bug), cron polling issues, and pending fix requests for the equipa Motoko canister.
